risk.risk: Task estimates and reuse of prior regression tests remain uncertain after one substantive decomposition pass
risk.impact: Some calibration estimates still exceed the two-day planning target; schedule projections are not delivery commitments
risk.mitigation: At task start inspect the actual changed scope and existing prerequisite tests; add only the new branch evidence. If the scope still exceeds two person-days, split it through a local contract patch while preserving all acceptance obligations. Never reduce acceptance or claim a projection was measured.
risk.trigger: Actual task inspection reveals independent responsibilities or more than two days of work; keep the affected task unlanded
